description: This file contains unit tests for the DeepLinkAgentPolicy component, including validation of message length handling, delivery options based on link properties, and channel-specific delivery logic.

classes.name: DeepLinkAgentPolicyTests
classes.description: A struct containing unit tests for DeepLinkAgentPolicy behaviors.

methods.name: validate message for handle rejects too long when unkeyed
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when an unkeyed message exceeds the maximum allowed length.

methods.name: validate message for handle allows too long when keyed
methods.description: Tests that validation succeeds when an excessively long message is provided but with a key, allowing longer messages.

methods.name: effective delivery ignores delivery fields when unkeyed
methods.description: Checks that delivery fields are ignored when the link has no key.

methods.name: effective delivery honors deliver for deliverable channels when keyed
methods.description: Verifies delivery options when a key is present and the channel supports delivery.

methods.name: effective delivery still blocks web chat delivery when keyed
methods.description: Ensures web chat delivery is blocked even when a key is provided.
